item.title: Unified framework shows thermoelectric performance depends on more than the material itself
item.description: Thermoelectric materials can directly convert heat into electricity, making them promising for recovering waste heat from factories, vehicles and other sources. These properties have attracted considerable interest in energy-saving technologies and thermal management. Fuente: Phys.org.
